lens: Recruitment operator — recovery and retry (simulated expertise/user lens)
reason: The inspected operator journey is thoughtfully guarded: review cohort workload and results, load fresh coverage, explicitly confirm irreversible grading closure, preview exact release outcomes, then resolve skipped applicants and review again. The synthetic desktop/mobile modal captures show clear consequence copy, restrained hierarchy and legible counts consistent with Precision Instrument; mobile requires scrolling to the final actions. Local tests support coverage retry and database rollback/idempotent release recovery, but these are synthetic fixtures, not observed operator success. The public proposition clearly identifies student consulting and separate client/student actions, with pro-bono scope and no invented case-study outcomes. Original-resume access is disclosed accurately. A stalled batch request still lacks bounded recovery, and no hosted authenticated acceptance exists, so neither world-class agreement nor deployment readiness is established.

findings.evidence: Both batch operations await authorizedFetch and response.json without an AbortSignal or timeout. src/lib/client-fetch.ts:authorizedFetch delegates directly to fetch and only handles 401 retry. The busy ref and pending state reset only in finally; while pending, the review and release controls are disabled. Unlike RoundStatusControl, these operations do not use fetchWithTimeout.
findings.userImpact: If a connection or response body stalls rather than rejects, the operator remains in Checking release…/Releasing… without reaching the recovery guidance or regaining controls. A manual page reload is the only visible escape, with release completion potentially unknown.
findings.suggestedFix: Bound the complete request/body-read lifecycle. On timeout, clear pending; for a potentially committed release, show an unknown-result receipt, refresh current outcomes and require a new preflight before retrying. Add a focused stalled-response test proving controls recover without automatically replaying a release.

notVerified: No staging or hosted integration exists: actual Clerk renewal, Supabase RPC/RLS, migration rollout, storage and email delivery were not exercised by this review.
No real recruitment operator completed the journey; source inspection, synthetic modal captures and intercepted-browser tests do not establish task success or recovery usability.
The close snapshot remains advisory until freeze; real concurrent operator/reviewer activity and remediation after an incomplete irreversible closure were not observed.

Full authenticated cohort/results/release screens lack supplied live captures; this review cannot establish their visual behavior at realistic cohort scale, assistive-technology usability, or Safari/Firefox/physical-device support.
Board approval of resume-review policy, approved client artifacts/outcomes, and actual delivery recovery remain external dependencies.
